planets.name: K2-85 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-85 with a 0.685-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-85 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-85. Its orbit and size follow Howard et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
